preconditions.description: The dimensions A and B of the picture must be positive integers not exceeding 20.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == B for line in picture)
preconditions.description: Each line of the picture must have exactly B characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() for line in picture for c in line)
preconditions.description: All characters in the picture must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the number of good puzzles.
The second line of output must contain the dimensions X and Y of the smallest good puzzle.
